question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

 __I am watching__ a movie, when my mother came into the room.
solution:
The correct answer is **'I was watching'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There is an error in the tense used in the underlined part *I am watching__*.
 
• The sentence is in the **past tense ***(came into the room). *
 
• *I am watching* is the **present continuous tense form of the verb **watch.
 
• So, we need to replace the underlined part with the past tense form of '**am**' which is **I was watching. **
 
• Hence, **option 2 **is the correct answer. 

**__Correct sentence__ - ** ***__I was watching__** a movie, when my mother came into the room.*
